description: SorryBench base question_ids whose prompt text appears verbatim in the SFT training split (00_data/train.json). Matching: lowercase + whitespace-collapse, exact string equality. These are excluded from the decontaminated SorryBench results to avoid train/test contamination.
matching_rule: norm(s)=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s.lower().strip()); exact equality against train.json prompts
